edits.new:
The member types beyond the legacy Java types (the JSON shape of `ruleResult.result`, the map of `inputs`, the decimal scale of `confidence` and of the cost fields) and the exact detail text of each refusal are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0620; ASM-0908); this document fixes the member names and leaves the types to the review with their owners. No table of any schema is declared as an answer source: the operations answer from `rwb_agent`, and the record is written by the caller's library into the caller's schema (DP-01, DP-03).

The extractor provider, model name, model version and field-extraction route of extraction_method MODEL are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1005); the route stays a property of rwb-document with no model name in code. The link operation path is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2187). The client builds the rule result first, starts AgentRunWorkflow on queue `rwb-agent` through this contract with the policy timeout of BR4, treats an expiry as TIMED_OUT with the rule result applied, and reads the run, its status and its fallback through GET /api/recovery/agent/v1/admin/agent-runs. The guardrail check codes are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0381) and are to be published with the policy schema, so that a fallback reason is always a code the agent returns.
